}}'''Sharmad Zeffer''' is a [[Domani]] refugee who emigrated to the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sharmad Zeffar}}

== Appearance ==
She is coppery-skinned and plump. She is a few years older than [[Faile Bashere]].

== Activities ==
Faile Bashere sends [[Rhea Avin]] and Sharmad to [[Daise Congar]] after they have been fighting over [[Wil al'Seen]].{{ref/book|6|Prologue}}
